basic_info.description: This beautifully renovated one-bedroom TIC in an eight-unit boutique building offers sophisticated indoor-outdoor living in the heart of Pacific Heights. The open-concept living and dining area flows seamlessly onto a generous, exclusive-use patio - an ideal extension of the home that functions as an outdoor lounge. Whether you're hosting friends for dinner al fresco, enjoying a quiet morning coffee, or simply unwinding in the fresh air, this private outdoor retreat adds a rare and valuable dimension to city living. The chef's kitchen is thoughtfully designed with stainless steel appliances, an eat-in peninsula, and abundant storage. The spacious bedroom features two large closets and a cozy, restful atmosphere. One-car parking and storage complete this exceptional residence. The building underwent an extensive renovation in 2018, including seismic upgrades. Just half a block from the vibrant shops and restaurants of Fillmore Street, and moments from Alta Plaza Park and Cow Hollow, this home blends modern comfort with an unbeatable location.
